units.source_text: 传来了“嘿嗬，嘿嗬，嘿嗬嗬”的吆喝声，可以看见消防队拖着水泵在街上走过。

en.t: The cry of "heave ho, heave ho, heave ho-ho" came drifting over, and they could see the fire brigade dragging a pump along the street.

units.source_text: 人们前呼后拥地在马路上奔跑。

en.t: People were running along the road in a pressing crowd, calling out to one another.

units.source_text: 岛村也急匆匆地走到马路上。

en.t: Shimamura also hurried out onto the road.

units.source_text: 他们两人来时走的那条路的尽头，和大马路连成了丁字形。

en.t: The road the two of them had taken on the way there ended at the main road, forming a T-junction.
